author: reek
body: The silence-only test for the `ir-check` IR validator. This is an ordinary program, and that is the whole point: compiled with `passes=fold-constants,ir-check,inline-leaf-calls,ir-check` it must produce a binary byte-identical to the default pipeline's, and print exactly what it prints under the default pipeline. A validator that fires on valid IR is worse than no validator, so the property under test is that nothing happens.

author: reek
body: The constructs here are the ones the scope walk has to get right: shadowed lets (an inner binder with the same name as an outer one), lambdas and their parameters, match branches whose patterns bind sub-names, recursion (a definition naming itself), calls to chapter definitions and to builtins by bare name, records and field access, and list literals.
